hazards.description: A utility pole is located directly in the center of the sidewalk path, significantly narrowing the effective walking width and creating a barrier for those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right of the image, on the sidewalk

hazards.name: Unmarked Wide Driveway
hazards.description: A wide driveway crosses the sidewalk without any markings or priority indicators, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, where the driveway meets the main road

hazards.name: Sun Glare
hazards.description: Significant sun glare is visible, which can severely reduce driver visibility of pedestrians and signals.

hazards.name: Lack of protected crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge areas visible, forcing pedestrians to cross a wide expanse of traffic unprotected.

hazards.name: Blank frontage
hazards.description: The fenced parking lot creates a lack of natural surveillance and a hostile pedestrian experience.
hazards.location_in_image: Far side of the street behind the sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians wishing to cross this wide, multi-lane road have no designated or protected crossing points visible.

hazards.name: High-speed road design
hazards.description: Wide, straight lanes without traffic calming measures encourage higher vehicle speeds, increasing the risk of severe injury in a collision.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and provide space for other modes or a median refuge.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to provide a safe crossing point for the hospital campus.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised concrete island in the median at the intersection to allow pedestrians to cross the wide road in two stages.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks with appropriate signage to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with RRFB
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to provide a safe crossing point for the institutional campus.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer for pedestrians and narrow the driver's visual field.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand exists, install a marked crossing with high-visibility paint and potentially a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB).

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with signage and potentially a Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk Crossing
interventions.description: Elevate the sidewalk across the driveway to maintain pedestrian priority and slow exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide safe pedestrian access.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand exists, install a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility markings and potentially a refuge island.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Street Trees
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Upgrade the painted bike lane to a physically protected lane to further buffer pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to improve pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Realignment
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk or relocate the utility pole to ensure a clear, unobstructed path of travel that meets accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian priority and slow entering/exiting vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to improve pedestrian comfort and safety from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: High-visibility mid-block crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with high-visibility paint and pedestrian warning signage to provide a legal and safer crossing point.
